# mergewf_organization_tool_access_policy (Resource)

Manages the complete organization default tool access policy. Import as organization. Destroy relinquishes management and leaves the remote policy unchanged because the API has no delete endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_organization_tool_access_policy" "example" {
  mode  = "NONE"
  rules = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) API field `mode`. Allowed values: `ALL`, `CUSTOM`, `NONE`.

### Optional

- `rules` (Attributes List) API field `rules`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. See the resource description for its import format.
- `result_json` (String) Complete API response encoded as JSON. Use jsondecode to access additional response fields. Stored in Terraform state.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) action. Allowed values: `ALLOW`, `DENY`.

Optional:

- `connector` (String) connector. Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 100.
- `tool` (String) tool. Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 200.
- `tool_class` (String) tool_class. Allowed values: `READ_ONLY`, `WRITE`, `DESTRUCTIVE`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergewf_organization_tool_access_policy.example organization
```
